questions: Where do you come from?

Do you think you will continue living there in the future?

How long have you lived in this city?

Where do you study? / Where is your school?

Is there anything you don't like about this job?
Will you change to another job in the future? / Have you ever thought about changing jobs?
Is there anything you would like to change about your work?
Why did you choose that job?
What's a typical day at work like for you?
Do you need any specific skills or abilities for your job?
Is there a place in your company that makes you feel relaxed?
What are the advantages of a company having a relaxation room?
Do you live in a house or a flat?
Who do you live with?
What do you like about the place you're living?
Is there anything you don't like about where you live?
Do you think the environment of your neighborhood is suitable for children?
What are the disadvantages of the place where you're living?
Are you familiar with the people living nearby?
What can you see from your window?
What kind of accommodation did you grow up in?
Which room do you like best?
Has anything changed in the place where you live?
What kind of house or at do you want to live in in the future?
Do you like the area that you live in?
Do you live in a noisy or a quiet area?
Where do you like to go in that area?
Do you know any famous people in your area?
What are some changes in the area recently?
Do you know any of your neighbours?
Are the people in your neighbourhood nice and friendly?
What are your favourite activities?
What were your favourite activities when you were a child?
Did you prefer to do activities alone or with a group of people when you were a child?
Is there something you liked as a child that you still enjoy now?
What do you think is the biggest difference between now and your childhood?
Who was the person who spent the most time with you when you were little?
Do you walk a lot?
Did you often go outside to go for a walk when you were a child?
Why do people like to walk in parks?
Where would you like to take a long walk if you had the chance?
Where did you go for a walk lately?
Do you look out of the window at the scenery when traveling by car or bus?
Do you like to take scenery pictures?
Do you prefer the mountains or the sea?
What are the most beautiful sights you have seen while traveling?
Do you like taking pictures of different views?
Do you prefer views in urban areas or rural areas?
Do you prefer views in your own country or in other countries?
Do you like getting up early in the morning?
What do you usually do in the morning?
What did you do in the morning when you were little? Why?
Are there any differences between what you do in the morning now and what you did in the past?
Do you spend your mornings doing the same things on both weekends and weekdays? Why?
What's your favourite food?
What kind of food did you like when you were young?
Do you eat different foods at different times of the year?
Has your favourite food changed since you were a child?
Do you have any hobbies?
Did you have any hobbies when you were a child?
Do you have a hobby that you've had since childhood?
Do you have the same hobbies as your family members?
Do you take photos of buildings?
Is there a building that you would like to visit?
Are there tall buildings near your home?
Do you want to live in a tall building?
Have you ever been part of a sports team?
Is team sports popular in your culture?
Do you like to watch team games? Why?
What are the differences between team sports and individual sports?
Do you prefer typing or handwriting?
Do you type on a desktop or laptop keyboard everyday?
When did you learn how to type on a keyboard?
How do you improve your typing?
At what age do you think people are the happiest?
Do you have any plans for the next ve years?
What do you think is the most important at the moment?
Are you satis ed with your current life?
What did you often do with your friends in your childhood?
How do people remember each stage of their lives?
Have you ever sent handmade gifts to others?
Have you ever received a great gift?
What do you consider when choosing a gift?
Do you think you are good at choosing gifts?
What gifts have you received recently?
What's your favourite animal? Why?
Where do you prefer to keep your pet, indoors or outdoors?
Have you ever had a pet before?
What is the most popular animal in China?
Do you like reading?
Do you prefer to read on paper or on a screen?
When do you need to read carefully, and when do you not need to?
Do you prefer scanning or detailed reading?
When was the last time you had a few days off?
What do you usually do when you have days off?
Do you usually spend your days off with your parents or your friends?
What would you like to do if you had a day off tomorrow?
Do you always bring a lot of keys with you?
Have you ever lost your keys?
Do you often forget the keys and lock yourself out?
Do you think it's a good idea to leave your keys with a neighbour?
Can you remember the dreams you had?
Do you share your dreams with others?
Do you think dreams have special meanings?
Do you want to make your dreams come true?
Do you have an experience that you did something well?
Do you have an experience that your teacher thought you did a good job?
Do you often tell your friends when they do something well?
Do you like buying shoes? How often?
Have you ever bought shoes online?
How much money do you usually spend on shoes?
Which do you prefer, fashionable shoes or comfortable shoes?
Are there any rules for students at your school?
Do you think students would benefit more from more rules?
Have you ever had a really dedicated teacher?
Do you prefer to have more or fewer rules at school?
Have you ever had a really strict teacher?
Would you like to work as a teacher in a rule-free school?
Have you ever talked with someone you don't know in public places?
Do you wear headphones in public places?
Would you like to see more public places near where you live?
Do you often go to public places with your friends?
Do you like art?
Do you like visiting art galleries?
Do you want to be an artist?
Do you like modern art or traditional art?
Do you keep plants at home?
What plant did you grow when you were young?
Do you know anything about growing a plant?
Do Chinese people send plants as gift?
Are you interested in growing vegetables and fruits?
Is growing vegetables popular in your country?
Do many people grow vegetables in your city?
Do you think it's easy to grow vegetables?
Should schools teach students how to grow vegetables?
Is the city where you live crowded?
Is there a crowded place where you live?
Do you like crowded places?
Do most people like crowded places?
When was the last time you were in a crowded place?
Do you bring food or snacks with you when going out?
Do you always take your mobile phone with you when going out?
Do you often carry cash with you?
How often do you use cash?
Have you ever worked with old people?
Are you happy to work with people who are older than you?
What are the benefits of being friends with or working with old people?
Do you enjoy spending time with old people?
Is there an advertisement that made an impression on you when you were a child?
Do you see a lot of advertising on trains or other transport?
Do you like advertisements?
What kind of advertising do you like?
Do you often see advertisements when you are on your phone or computer?
Have you borrowed books from others?
Have you ever borrowed money from others?
Do you like to lend things to others?
How do you feel when people don't return things they borrowed from you?
Do you mind if others borrow money from you?
Do you like chatting with friends?
What do you usually chat about with friends?
Do you prefer to chat with a group of people or with only one friend?
Do you prefer to communicate face-to-face or via social media?
Do you argue with friends?
Do you often visit a museum?
Are there many museums in your hometown?
Do you think museums are important?
When was the last time you visited a museum?
How often do you take a rest or a break?
What do you usually do when you are resting?
Do you take a nap when you are taking your rest?
How do you feel after taking a nap?
Did your parents teach you to share when you were a child?
What kind of things do you like to share with others?
What kind of things are not suitable for sharing?
Do you have anything to share with others recently?
Who is the first person you would like to share good news with?
Do you prefer to share news with your friends or your parents?
Do you have a friend you have known for a long time?
What do you usually do with your friends?
Where do you often meet each other?
Do you often go out with your friends?
How important are friends to you?
Do you prefer to spend time with one friend or with a group of friends?
Would you invite friends to your home?
Is there a difference between where you meet friends now and where you used to meet them in the past?
Why are some places suitable for meeting while others are not?

part2.title: A Person Who Solved a Problem
part2.cue_text: Describe a person who solved a problem in a smart way. You should say: who he / she is what the problem was how he or she solved it And explain why you think he / she did it in a smart way.
part3_questions: How do children become smart at school?
Do you think children are born smart or they learn to become smart?
Why does modern society need talents of all kinds?
Why are some people well rounded and others only good at one thing?

part2.title: A Person Who Protects the Nature
part2.cue_text: Describe a person who encouraged you to protect the nature. You should say: who this person is how he / she encouraged you what he / she encourage you to do And explain how you feel about this person.
part3_questions: How can parents teach the children to protect the nature?
Should schools teach children to get close to nature?
Do you think there should be laws to protect nature?
Do all people need some nature?
Are people hard-wired to protect the environment?

part2.title: A Helpful Person
part2.cue_text: Describe a person who often helps others You should say: who this person is how often he / she helps others how / why he / she helps others And explain how you feel about this person.
part3_questions: What kind of help do people need when looking for a new job?
What can children do to help their parents?
Who should people ask for help, colleagues or family members?
Should children help their parents with household chores?
Do you think schools should teach children to do household chores?
Why are employees reluctant to ask their managers to help?

part2.title: An Organized Person
part2.cue_text: Describe a person who makes plans a lot and is good at planning. You should say: who he / she is how you knew him / her what plans he / she makes. And explain how you feel about this person.
part3_questions: What activities do we need to plan ahead?
Do you think it's important to plan ahead?
Is making study plans popular among young people?
Should children ask their teachers or parents for advice when making plans?
Do you think children should plan their future careers?
Do you think choosing a college major is closely related to a future career?

part2.title: A Child Who Loves To Draw
part2.cue_text: Describe a child who loves drawing or painting. You should say: who this person is how / when you knew him / her how often he / she draws / paints And explain why you think he / she loves drawing / painting.
part3_questions: Why do most children draw more often than adults do?
What is the right age for a child to learn drawing?
Why do some people visit art galleries or museums instead of viewing artworks online?
What are the differences between reading a book and visiting a museum?
Do you think galleries and museums should be free of charge?
How do artworks inspire people?

part2.title: A Person Who Learned a Skill
part2.cue_text: Describe one of your friends who learned something without a teacher. You should say: who this person is what skill he / she learned how he / she learned And explain whether it would be easier to learn from a teacher.
part3_questions: Is it necessary to keep learning after graduating from school?
Should teachers make learning in their classes fun?
Which do you think is more important practical skills or academic skills?
Which age group is better at learning new things?
What can be done to improve modern teaching methods?
Why do some young people refuse to learn from older people?
Do you think there are too many subjects for students to learn?
Is it better to focus on a few subjects or to learn many subjects?
Do you think enterprises should provide training for their employees?
Do you think it is good for older adults to continue learning?

part2.title: A Famous Person
part2.cue_text: Describe a famous person you would like to meet. You should say: who he / she is how you knew him / her how and where you would like to meet him / her And explain why you would like to meet him / her.
part3_questions: What are the advantages and disadvantages of being a famous child?
What can children do with their fame?
What can today's children do to become famous?
Is it easy to become famous in your country?
Do people become famous because of their talent?
Do you think that most people want to become famous?

part2.title: An Important Friend
part2.cue_text: Describe a good friend who is important to you. You should say: who he / she is how / where you got to know him / her how long you have known each other And explain why he / she is important to you.
part3_questions: How do children make friends at school?
How do children make friends when they are not at school?
Do you think it is better for children to have a few close friends or many casual friends?
Do you think a child's relationship with friends can be replaced by that with other people, like parents or other family members?
What are the differences between friends made inside and outside the workplace?
Do you think it's possible for bosses and their employees to become friends?

part2.title: A Person Who Enjoys Working for a Family Business
part2.cue_text: Describe a person you know who enjoys working for a family business (e.g. a shop, etc.). You should say: who he / she is what the business is what his / her job is And explain why he / she enjoys working there.
part3_questions: Would you like to start a family business?
Would you like to work in a family business?
Why do some people choose to start their own company?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of family business?
What family businesses do you know in your local area?
What makes a successful family business?

part2.title: A Friend Who Is Good at Music
part2.cue_text: Describe a friend of yours who is good at music / singing. You should say: who he / she is when / where you listen to his / her music / singing what kind of music / songs he / she is good at And explain how you feel when listening to his / her music / singing.
part3_questions: What kind of music is popular in your country?
What kind of music do young people like?
Do you think music is bene cial for children at school?
What are the benefits of children learning a musical instrument?
Do you know what kind of music children like today?
Do you think the government should invest more money on concerts?

part2.title: A Creative Person
part2.cue_text: Describe a creative person (e.g. an artist, a musician, an architect etc.) you admire. You should say: who he/she is how you knew him/her what his/her greatest achievement is And explain why you think he/she is creative.
part3_questions: Do you think children should learn to play musical instruments?
How do artists acquire inspiration?
Do you think pictures and videos in news reports are important?
What can we do to help children keep creative?
How does drawing help to enhance children's creativity?
What kind of jobs require creativity?

part2.title: A Sportsperson
part2.cue_text: Describe a successful sportsperson you admire. You should say: who he / she is what you know about him / her what he / she is like in real life what achievement he / she has made And explain why you admire him / her.
part3_questions: Should students have physical education and do sports at school?
What qualities should an athlete have?
Is talent important in sports?
Is it easy to identify children's talents?
What is the most popular sports in your country?
Why are there so few top athletes?

part2.title: A Popular Person
part2.cue_text: Describe a popular person. You should say: who this person is what kind of person he or she is when you see him / her normally And explain why you think this person is popular.
part3_questions: Why are some students popular in school?
Is it important for a teacher to be popular?
Do you think good teachers are always popular among students?
What are the qualities of being a good teacher?
Is it easier to become popular nowadays?
Why do people want to be popular?

part2.title: A Foreign Country
part2.cue_text: Describe a foreign country you would like to stay or work for a short period of time. You should say: which country it is where you got to know this country what you will do there And explain why you will stay or work there just for a short period of time.
part3_questions: Why do people sometimes go to other cities or other countries to travel?
Is it important to take photos while traveling?
Can you trust other people's travel journals on the Internet?
What factors affect how people feel about traveling?
Will you go to a foreign country to travel because of the distinct landscape?
How can tourists have a good travel experience?
What kinds of comments do travelers typically leave online after a trip?

part2.title: A Shopping Mall
part2.cue_text: Describe a shopping mall. You should say: where it is what its name is how often you visit it And what you usually buy at the mall.
part3_questions: Why do people buy things they don't need?
Do people in your country go to the shopping mall frequently?
How have people's shopping habits changed in recent decades?
Do you think shops and shopping malls will disappear in the future?
What are the differences between shopping in street markets and big shopping malls?
What are the differences in the shopping habits of different age groups?
What are the differences between shopping online and instore?

part2.title: An Interesting Building
part2.cue_text: Describe an interesting building. You should say: what it looks like where it is what function it has And explain why you think it is interesting.
part3_questions: What types of buildings are popular in your country?
Is it more important for a building to look good on the outside or on the inside?
Why do people like to visit historical sites?
Is it worth spending a lot of money on the exterior appearance of a building?
Do you think a city's buildings affect its vibe or atmosphere?
Do you think old buildings should be preserved?

part2.title: A Relaxing Place
part2.cue_text: Describe your favorite place in your house where you can relax. You should say: where it is what it is like what you enjoy doing there And explain why you feel relaxed at this place.
part3_questions: What are the benefits of doing exercise?
Why is it dif cult for some people to relax?
Which is more important, mental relaxation or physical relaxation?
What is the place where people spend most of their time at home?
Do you think there should be classes for training young people and children how to relax?
Do people in your country exercise after work?

part2.title: A Natural Place
part2.cue_text: Describe a natural place (e.g. parks, mountains, etc.). You should say: where this place is how you knew this place what it is like And explain why you like to visit it.
part3_questions: What kind of people like to visit natural places?
What are the differences between a natural place and a city?
Do you think that going to the park is the only way to get close to nature?
What can people gain from going to natural places?
Are there any wild animals in the city?
Do you think it is a good idea to let animals stay in local parks for people to see?

part2.title: An Interesting Building
part2.cue_text: Describe an interesting building you saw during a trip. You should say: where you saw it what it looks like what you have known about it And explain why you think it is interesting.
part3_questions: Should all scenic spots charge an entry fee?
Is visiting scenic spots the best choice for us while traveling?
Why do some people like to live in big cities?
Is it necessary for tourists to go to visit landmarks when traveling in a place?
Which do most people prefer, living in a bungalow or in a tall building?

part2.title: A Place With a Lot of Trees
part2.cue_text: Describe a place with a lot of trees that you would like to visit (e.g. a forest, oasis). You should say: where it is how you knew this place what it was like And explain why you would like to visit it.
part3_questions: Why do people like visiting places with trees or forests?
Are natural views better than city views?
Do all people need some nature?
Are people hard-wired to protect the environment?

part2.title: An Important Old Thing in Family
part2.cue_text: Describe something important that has been kept in your family for a long time. You should say: what it is when your family had it how your family got it And explain why it is important to your family.
part3_questions: What things do families keep for a long time?
What's the difference between things valued by people in the past and today.
What kinds of things are kept in museums?
Why do people visit museums?
What are the benefits of technology for learning history?
What's the influence of technology on museums?

part2.title: An Expensive Item
part2.cue_text: Describe an item on which you spent more than expected. You should say: what it is how much you spent on it why you bought it And explain why you think you spent more than expected.
part3_questions: What do you think young people spend most of their money on?
What kind of things are people happy to pay a high price for?
Do people buy things they don't need?
Do you often buy more than you expected?
Do you think it is important to save money? Why?
Do you think it is the rich people's responsibility to donate money to people in need?

part2.title: A Piece of Technology
part2.cue_text: Describe a piece of technology (not a phone) that you would like to own. You should say: what it is how much it costs how you knew it And explain why you would like to own it.
part3_questions: What technology do young people like to use?
What are the differences between the technology of the past and that of today?
What are the differences between online and face-toface communication?
What are the differences between making friends in real life and online?
What kind of technologies can be used at school?
What negative effects does technology have on people's relationship?
Do those electronic products benefit students?
Do you think middle school students should own computers?
Do you think robots can replace human teachers?

part2.title: Something You Can’t Live Without
part2.cue_text: Describe something that you can't live without (not a computer / phone). You should say: what it is what you do with it how it helps you in your life And explain why you can't live without it.
part3_questions: Why do all children like toys?
Why are children attracted to new things (such as electronics)?
Why do some grown-ups hate to throw out old things (such as clothes)?
Is the way people buy things affected? How?

What do you think influences people to buy new things? tablet fancy black, stunning cracks, screen, mean relatively big, a bit heavy study/video games-home, composing-sometimes, alsofilms irreplaceable-online, Internet, big screen

part2.title: A Wild Animal
part2.cue_text: Describe a wild animal that you want to know more about. You should say: what it is when / where you saw it why you want to know more about it And explain what you want to know more about it.
part3_questions: Why should we protect wild animals?
Why are some people more willing to protect wild animals than others?
Do you think it's important to take children to the zoo to see animals?
Why do people attach more importance to protecting rare animals?
Should people educate children to protect wild animals?
Is it more important to protect wild animals or the environment?

part2.title: A Toy
part2.cue_text: Describe a toy you liked in your childhood. You should say: what kind of toy it is when you received it how you played it And explain how you felt about it.
part3_questions: How do advertisements influence children?
Should advertising aimed at kids be prohibited?
What's the difference between the toys kids play now and those they played in the past?
Do you think parents should buy more toys for their kids or spend more time with them?
What's the difference between the toys boys play with and girls play with?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of modern toys?

part2.title: An Old Thing
part2.cue_text: Describe an important old thing that your family has kept for a long time. You should say: what it is how / when your family first got this thing how long your family has kept it And explain why this thing is important to your family.
part3_questions: What kind of old things do people like to keep?
Why do people keep old things?
What are the differences between the things old people keep and those young people keep?
What are the differences between the things that people keep today and the things that people kept in the past?
What can we see in a museum?
What can we learn from a museum?

part2.title: A Perfect Job
part2.cue_text: Describe your perfect job. You should say: what it is where you heard about it from what you need to learn to get the job And explain why you think it is your perfect job.
part3_questions: What jobs do children want to do when they grow up?
What kind of jobs are the most popular in your country?
What kind of job can be called a ‘dream job'?
Do people's ideal jobs change as they grow up?
What should people consider when choosing jobs?
Is salary the main reason people choose a certain job?

part2.title: A Movie You Watched Recently
part2.cue_text: Describe a movie you watched and enjoyed recently. You should say: when and where you watched it who you watched it with what it was about And explain why you watched this movie.
part3_questions: What kind of movies do you think are successful in your country?
What are the factors that make a successful movie?
Do Chinese people prefer to watch domestic movies or foreign movies?
Do you think only world-known directors can create the best movies?
Why do people prefer to watch movies in the cinema?
Do you think successful movies should have more known actors or actresses in leading roles?

part2.title: A Disappointing Movie
part2.cue_text: Describe a movie you watched recently that you felt disappointed about. You should say: when it was why you didn't like it why you decided to watch it And explain why you felt disappointed about it.
part3_questions: Do you believe movie reviews?
What are the different types of lms in your country?
Why are Japanese animated lms so popular?
Should the director pay a lot of money to famous actors?
Do you think lms with famous actors or actresses are more likely to become successful lms?
Are historical lms popular in your country? Why?

part2.title: An App
part2.cue_text: Describe a program or app on your computer or phone. You should say: what it is when / how you use it where you found it And explain how you feel about it.
part3_questions: What are the differences between old and young people when using apps?
Why do some people not like using apps?
What apps are popular in your country, why?
Do you think young people rely more and more on these programs?
Should parents limit their children using computer programs and computer games?

part2.title: A Story
part2.cue_text: Describe a story (e.g. a fairy tale, etc.) you have read recently. You should say: what it is about when you read it whether you liked it And explain what you have learned from it.
part3_questions: Why do most children like listening to stories before bedtime?
What lms are popular in China right now?
Is a good storyline important for a movie?
Do you think lms with many celebrities are more likely to be popular?

part2.title: A Useful Book
part2.cue_text: Describe a book you read that you found useful. You should say: what it is when you read it why you think it is useful And explain how you felt about it.
part3_questions: What are the types of books that young people like to read?
What should government do to make libraries better?
Do you think old people spend more time reading than young people?
Which one is better, paper books or e-books?
Have libraries changed a lot with the development of the internet?
What should we do to prevent modern libraries from closing down?

part2.title: A Traditional Story
part2.cue_text: Describe an interesting traditional story. You should say: what the story is about when / how you knew it who told you the story And explain how you felt when you first heard it.
part3_questions: What kind of stories do children like?
What are the benefits of bedtime stories for children?
Why do most children like listening to stories before bedtime?
What can children learn from stories?
Do all stories for children have happy endings?
Is a good storyline important for a movie?

part2.title: A Talent You Want To Improve
part2.cue_text: Describe a natural talent (sport, music, etc.) you want to improve. You should say: what it is when you discovered it how you want to improve it And explain how you feel about it.
part3_questions: Do you think artists with talents should focus on their talents?
Is it possible for us to know whether children who are 3 or 4 years old will become musicians and painters when they grow up?
Why do people like to watch talent shows?
Do you think it is more interesting to watch famous people's or ordinary people's shows?
Do you think it's important to develop children's talents?
Why do some people like to show their talents online?

part2.title: A Good Habit
part2.cue_text: Describe a good habit your friend has and you want to develop. You should say: who your friend is what habit he / she has when you noticed this habit And explain why you want to develop this habit.
part3_questions: What habits should children have?
What should parents do to teach their children good habits?
